own_solution.law: Grating equation at normal incidence: d sin(theta) = m lambda; separation = asin(2*650/4000) - asin(2*450/4000)

defect_reasons.other: The screen sentences (T2E60, TBC0D) refer to 'the screen' although no screen is introduced in the problem, which is slightly awkward wording.

notes: Base: sin(theta_450) = 0.225, theta = 0.226943 rad = 13.0029 deg; sin(theta_650) = 0.325, theta = 0.331012 rad = 18.9656 deg; separation 0.104069 rad = 5.9627 deg. With 560 nm replacing 450 nm: sin = 0.28, theta = 0.283794 rad = 16.2602 deg; separation 0.047218 rad = 2.7054 deg. Target unit not specified in the problem; I report degrees. The screen distance does not enter the angle; I class it D (the angle is fixed by the grating equation), though it could also be seen as C/K-type (relevant only for linear separations or near-field); the stratum depends on the authors' framing. TFEEC (light entering the second spectrometer) is D.
